hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or ""; r=os.path.realpath(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR") or os.getcwd()); q=os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(r,p)),r); sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked by repo policy: dist/ is generated (edit src/super-review/ and run make build); docs/ORIGINAL_REVIEW_PROMPT.md is archival provenance."}})) if q.split(os.sep)[0]=="dist" or q==os.path.join("docs","ORIGINAL_REVIEW_PROMPT.md") else None'
